tools.name: list_design_styles
tools.description: List the design styles Roomvana can render (e.g. modern, japandi, industrial), each with a short description.

tools.name: list_room_types
tools.description: List the room and outdoor space types Roomvana can redesign (interior rooms, house exterior, and garden/outdoor spaces).

tools.name: design_a_room
tools.description: Turn a room + style choice into a Roomvana studio link with those options pre-selected. The user opens the link, uploads a photo of the room, and gets an AI redesign. Validates the room and style against Roomvana's catalogue.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_design_styles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the interior-design styles Roomvana can render (e.g. modern, japandi, industrial), each with a short description. Use this to pick a `style` for design_a_room." → after: "List the design styles Roomvana can render (e.g. modern, japandi, industrial), each with a short description."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
